title.zh: Brazil’s $252 billion crypto market gets $10,000 self-custody reporting rule
title.en: Brazil’s $252 billion crypto market gets $10,000 self-custody reporting rule

current_state.zh: Brazil will require central-bank-authorized institutions to report crypto transfers of $10,000 or more to and from self-custody wallets starting Oct. 1 under Resolution BCB 588, expanding AML oversight over its $252.5 billion crypto market.
current_state.en: Brazil will require central-bank-authorized institutions to report crypto transfers of $10,000 or more to and from self-custody wallets starting Oct. 1 under Resolution BCB 588, expanding AML oversight over its $252.5 billion crypto market.
